systems_found: South Dakota Board of Regents (6 universities: USD, SDSU, SD Mines, NSU, DSU, BHSU, plus 2 special schools)
South Dakota Board of Technical Education (4 technical colleges: Lake Area, Mitchell, Southeast, Western Dakota)

sources.institution: State employees (Board of Regents institutions likely included; not verified)
sources.system: Open SD (Bureau of Finance and Management) - Payroll > Employee Salaries
sources.coverage_years: current ('constantly updated' from the state payroll system)
sources.institutions_covered: state agencies; whether Board of Regents universities appear could not be verified; technical colleges are probably not included (they are not on state payroll)
sources.blocker: robots.txt disallows all crawling of open.sd.gov, and the salaries tool is an interactive ASP.NET search; no bulk file found.
sources.notes: The home page says users can review 'salaries of individual state employees'. Because of the robots.txt Disallow-all I did not open the salaries page (only the home page was fetched once, before reading robots). A bulk extract would likely need a records request to BFM. A separate Executive Salaries page (https://open.sd.gov/executive_salaries.aspx, statutory list under SDCL 4-7-10.1, May 18, 2026 snapshot) lists only top executives, e.g. the BOR Executive Director.
Only salary ranges, no person-level data. The BOR personnel manual says name, title, salary, institution and department number may be released on request.

sources.institutions_covered: all state budget units incl. BOR
sources.notes: Aggregate budget/spending only, not payroll by person.

private_extra: None found; Augustana, University of Sioux Falls, Dakota Wesleyan, Mount Marty publish only IRS 990 data.
gaps: No downloadable or crawlable person-level higher-ed pay. Open SD is the only official listing and it forbids crawling. Technical colleges (governed via local school districts / Board of Technical Education) have no published pay lists. No news-org salary database found (Argus Leader, SD Searchlight).
notes: Honored open.sd.gov robots.txt (Disallow: /) after discovering it, so the Employee Salaries page itself was not inspected; fields and coverage there are inferred, not verified. Would need a human browser check or a records request to confirm whether BOR employees are listed.
